data.title: Junior Back End - Python Developer
data.description_html:
Job Title: Backend Developer (Python, FastAPI) – Onsite in Ha Noi

We are looking for a Backend Developer (Python) with at least 1.5 years of experience to join a project where deep business understanding matters as much as clean, well-designed code.

In this role, you will own backend features end-to-end: working with international stakeholders to understand and analyse the business domain, designing and building APIs with FastAPI, and optimising database performance. We are looking for someone who takes real ownership of what they build, learns a new domain fast, and enjoys hard problems rather than avoiding them. For engineers who want it, there is a clear growth path towards a technical leadership role.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
  • Work directly with clients and product owners to explore, analyse, and clarify business requirements, then translate them into technical solutions.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned modules: requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, release, and production support.
  • Optimise database performance: schema and data model design, query tuning, indexing strategy, execution plan analysis, and resolving bottlenecks.
  • Investigate and solve complex or ambiguous technical problems where the answer is not documented anywhere.
  • Safeguard code quality, security, and maintainability through code reviews, automated tests, and engineering best practices.
  • Join regular online meetings with international clients (evening meetings may be required).

Your Skills & Experience

  • At least 1.5 years of experience in backend development with Python.
  • Strong hands-on experience with FastAPI (or Flask/Django with a clear willingness to move to FastAPI), asynchronous programming, and Pydantic.
  • Solid database skills with PostgreSQL or MySQL: data modelling, query optimisation, indexing, transactions, and profiling slow queries.
  • Strong business analysis mindset: able to ask the right questions, challenge unclear requirements, and understand the “why” behind every feature.
  • High ownership: comfortable being the accountable person for a module or business domain, not just an executor of tickets.
  • Fluent English (speaking and writing) — able to work directly with international clients and stakeholders without a translator.
  • Fast learner with a proven record of picking up unfamiliar business domains or technologies quickly.
  • Willingness to work on hard problems: performance issues, unclear specifications, legacy code, and deep debugging.
  • Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS is a plus).

Nice to Have

  • Ambition and potential to grow into a Technical Lead / Team Lead role.
  • Experience with Redis, Celery, or message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Experience with data-intensive systems, ETL/data pipelines, or time-series data.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (pytest) and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Understanding of security best practices (OWASP, authentication and authorisation design).
  • Background in a domain-heavy industry such as energy, finance, healthcare, or logistics.
  • Exposure to integrating AI/LLM capabilities into backend services.

Benefits

  • Attractive, negotiable salary plus performance-based bonus.
  • Full benefits according to Vietnam Labour Law (social and health insurance).
  • International, professional, young and innovative working environment.
  • A clear technical growth path, including mentoring and leadership opportunities.
  • Opportunity to work directly with global experts and join technology conferences and workshops.
  • Holidays and paid leave according to Vietnam Labour Law.
  • Company trips and team-building activities.

Contact – SETA International Vietnam

📍 HL Tower, 82 Duy Tan, Ha Noi

✉️ hien.nguyen@seta-international.vn

🌐 https://www.seta-international.com/

📘 https://www.facebook.com/SETA.International.careers/

data.title: Senior Fullstack Python Developer (Good English)
data.location: Ho Chi Minh City Metropolitan Area
data.description_html:
Our Company

We're Hitachi Digital Services, a global digital solutions and transformation business with a bold vision of our world's potential. We're people-centric and here to power good. Every day, we future-proof urban spaces, conserve natural resources, protect rainforests, and save lives. This is a world where innovation, technology, and deep expertise come together to take our company and customers from what's now to what's next. We make it happen through the power of acceleration.

Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to bring a better tomorrow closer to today. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Python Developer (Good English) with 4+ years of experience in software development, strong expertise in Python, Microservices, Azure, Kubernetes, and React/Angular, and hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions using Azure OpenAI Service, including Agentic AI, Copilot, and reasoning agents.

Key Requirements

  • Good English communication
  • Strong Python development experience using FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
  • Solid understanding of Microservices Architecture and RESTful API development.
  • Experience with OAuth2/OIDC, authentication, authorization, and secure API design.
  • Strong frontend development experience with React or Angular (preferred); experience with Vue.js is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and/or SQL Server, including database design and query optimization.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), and Microsoft Azure cloud services.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security practices including RBAC, encryption, and security best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Hands-on experience using AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar.
  • Experience developing or integrating solutions using Azure OpenAI Service, including:
    • AI Copilots
    • Agentic AI applications
    • Reasoning Agents
    • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
    • LLM integrations
  • Understanding of AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
Nice to Have

  • Experience with gRPC and cross-platform microservices integration.
  • Basic knowledge of Neo4j, Graph Database, and Cypher.
  • Experience in Manufacturing, Logistics, Transportation, or Rail domains.
  • Azure certifications such as AZ-204 or equivalent.
  • Experience designing and deploying enterprise AI Agents and Copilot solutions.

About Us

We're a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you.

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

How we look after you

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

Employment Type: Vietnamese - Full-time 


DAC Data Technology Vietnam is a subsidiary of Hakuhodo DY One, a leader in Japan’s online advertising industry.  

Our main business content is Product Development & Data Science.  

In product development, we have provided consulting and development across a wide range of advertising technologies.  

In the data business, beyond analytics we integrate and enrich data to deliver actionable business value.  

With an experienced engineering team, we consistently enhance our clients’ operational efficiency and business outcomes. 

 

JOB DESCRIPTION 

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance server-side applications using Python.  
  • Design, implement, and optimize RESTful APIs and backend services.  
  • Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code.  
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues, and contribute to system improvements.  
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.  
  • Ensure application performance, security, reliability, and scalability. 

 

REQUIREMENTS 

Must have: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.  
  • At least 3 years of relevant work experience.  
  • Strong proficiency in Python, OOP, and related frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI).  
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis), including schema design and query optimization.  
  • Good understanding of RESTful APIs, API design, authentication mechanisms (JWT/OAuth2), microservices, and web architecture.  
  • Familiarity with version control systems, preferably Git. 
  • Testing: pytest/unittest; code style PEP 8; typing/annotations. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a team. 

 

Nice to have: 

  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus. 
  • Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, ..) 
  • Docker; ability to write/model design documents (UML, sequence/ER diagrams). 
  • TDD; UI testing (Selenium/Playwright). 
  • Data workflows: Airflow/Prefect; ETL/streaming basics. 
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor). 

 

 

BENEFITS 

# Career path improvement 

  • Work, learn and develop with young and talented colleagues who are passionate and have big vision 
  • Challenge yourself with new technologies and hot tech trends in the world 
  • Participate in training programs on technical skills, soft skills and working methods 
  • Be advised and share about career path and self-development. 

 

# Income 

  • Salary: Negotiable. Twice-a-year bonus   
  • Probation: 100% salary  
  • Performance review: Every January  
  • Japanese, TOEIC allowance; Technical Certificates allowance 

 

# Healthcare 

  • Premium healthcare for yourself and family members 
  • Annual health checkups at prestigious hospitals. 
  • Women care regimen: Women physiological rest: 8 hours/month; Postpartum rest for female staff with children under 2-year-old: 1h/day 
  • Premium health insurance (Bao Viet Tokio Marine) for yourself; and your family (for level Leader & Manager 

 

# Company activities 

  • Annual company trips, various exciting events at the most luxurious hotels twice a year 
  • Monthly allowance for team activities   
  • Happy hours & daily fruits   
  • Working time: 8:00 – 17:00 (Monday – Friday), Days Off: Saturday – Sunday and holidays, Tet in accordance with Vietnam Labor Law
